result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: overlapping text on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card where the delivery time and an 'Order' link render on top of each other, making both hard to read.

issues.description: On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the text '25–30 min delivery • Ramen' overlaps with an 'Order' link, rendering as garbled overlapping text ('25–30Order min delivery').
issues.suggestion: Separate the delivery time line and the 'Order' link into distinct elements or give the 'Order' link its own reserved space so they don't overlap.
